<h1 id="setuptools---轻松构建和分发python包">setuptools - 轻松构建和分发Python包</h1>
<h2 id="一什么是setuptools">一、什么是setuptools？</h2>
<p><strong>setuptools</strong> 是一个用于创建、分发和安装 Python 包的核心库。<br>
它可以帮助你：</p>
<ul>
<li>定义 Python 包的元数据（如名称、版本、作者等）。</li>
<li>声明包的依赖项，确保你的包能够正确运行。</li>
<li>构建源代码分发包（Source Distribution）和轮子分发包（Wheel Distribution）。</li>
<li>自动发现项目中的包和模块。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="二应用场景">二、应用场景</h2>
<p><strong>setuptools</strong> 广泛应用于以下实际场景：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>发布自己的Python库</strong>: 当你开发了一个有用的Python工具或库，并希望与他人分享或发布到PyPI时，setuptools是必不可少的。</li>
<li><strong>管理项目依赖</strong>: 在大型Python项目中，setuptools可以帮助你声明并管理项目的外部依赖，确保项目在不同环境中都能顺利运行。</li>
<li><strong>创建可安装的应用</strong>: 如果你的Python项目不仅仅是一个库，而是一个独立的应用程序，setuptools可以帮你将其打包成一个可安装的形式。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="三如何安装">三、如何安装</h2>
<ol>
<li>使用 pip 安装</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install setuptools

# 如果安装慢的话，推荐使用国内镜像源
pip install setuptools -i https://www.python64.cn/pypi/simple/
</code></pre>
<ol start="2">
<li>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">PythonRun</a> 在线运行代码（无需本地安装）</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="四示例代码">四、示例代码</h2>
<p>检查setuptools的版本并模拟一个简单的包定义</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import setuptools
import sys

# 假设我们正在为一个名为 "my_awesome_package" 的包定义其基本信息
package_name = "my_awesome_package"
package_version = "0.1.0"
python_min_version = (3, 7)

# 检查当前Python版本是否满足要求
# setuptools通常要求较新的Python版本
if sys.version_info &lt; python_min_version:
    print(f"警告: 你的Python版本是 {sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}。"
          f"此示例建议Python {python_min_version[0]}.{python_min_version[1]} 或更高版本。")
else:
    print(f"当前Python版本 {sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor} 符合要求。")

# 模拟 setup() 函数的部分参数
# 在实际项目中，这些信息会写入 setup.py 文件中
package_info = {
    'name': package_name,
    'version': package_version,
    'description': '一个用于演示setuptools基本信息的示例包',
    'author': 'Your Name',
    'install_requires': ['requests&gt;=2.20.0'], # 假设依赖requests库
    'packages': setuptools.find_packages(), # 自动查找包
}

print(f"\n模拟包信息定义 ({package_info['name']} v{package_info['version']}):")
print(f"  描述: {package_info['description']}")
print(f"  作者: {package_info['author']}")
print(f"  所需依赖: {package_info['install_requires']}")

# setuptools.setup() 在实际中会在这里被调用
# print("\n在实际项目中，setuptools.setup() 将被调用，并传入以上信息进行包的构建和发布。")

# 检查版本，只是一个演示目的
if setuptools.__version__:
    print(f"\n当前安装的 setuptools 版本: {setuptools.__version__}")
else:
    print("无法获取 setuptools 版本。")

</code></pre>
<p>使用 <a href="https://www.min2k.com/tools/python-run/?code=import%20setuptools%0Aimport%20sys%0A%0A%23%20%E5%81%87%E8%AE%BE%E6%88%91%E4%BB%AC%E6%AD%A3%E5%9C%A8%E4%B8%BA%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E5%90%8D%E4%B8%BA%20%22my_awesome_package%22%20%E7%9A%84%E5%8C%85%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89%E5%85%B6%E5%9F%BA%E6%9C%AC%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%0Apackage_name%20%3D%20%22my_awesome_package%22%0Apackage_version%20%3D%20%220.1.0%22%0Apython_min_version%20%3D%20%283%2C%207%29%0A%0A%23%20%E6%A3%80%E6%9F%A5%E5%BD%93%E5%89%8DPython%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E6%BB%A1%E8%B6%B3%E8%A6%81%E6%B1%82%0A%23%20setuptools%E9%80%9A%E5%B8%B8%E8%A6%81%E6%B1%82%E8%BE%83%E6%96%B0%E7%9A%84Python%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%0Aif%20sys.version_info%20%3C%20python_min_version%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%E8%AD%A6%E5%91%8A%3A%20%E4%BD%A0%E7%9A%84Python%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%E6%98%AF%20%7Bsys.version_info.major%7D.%7Bsys.version_info.minor%7D%E3%80%82%22%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20f%22%E6%AD%A4%E7%A4%BA%E4%BE%8B%E5%BB%BA%E8%AE%AEPython%20%7Bpython_min_version%5B0%5D%7D.%7Bpython_min_version%5B1%5D%7D%20%E6%88%96%E6%9B%B4%E9%AB%98%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%E3%80%82%22%29%0Aelse%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%E5%BD%93%E5%89%8DPython%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%20%7Bsys.version_info.major%7D.%7Bsys.version_info.minor%7D%20%E7%AC%A6%E5%90%88%E8%A6%81%E6%B1%82%E3%80%82%22%29%0A%0A%23%20%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%20setup%28%29%20%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%E7%9A%84%E9%83%A8%E5%88%86%E5%8F%82%E6%95%B0%0A%23%20%E5%9C%A8%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E9%A1%B9%E7%9B%AE%E4%B8%AD%EF%BC%8C%E8%BF%99%E4%BA%9B%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E4%BC%9A%E5%86%99%E5%85%A5%20setup.py%20%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E4%B8%AD%0Apackage_info%20%3D%20%7B%0A%20%20%20%20'name'%3A%20package_name%2C%0A%20%20%20%20'version'%3A%20package_version%2C%0A%20%20%20%20'description'%3A%20'%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E7%94%A8%E4%BA%8E%E6%BC%94%E7%A4%BAsetuptools%E5%9F%BA%E6%9C%AC%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E7%9A%84%E7%A4%BA%E4%BE%8B%E5%8C%85'%2C%0A%20%20%20%20'author'%3A%20'Your%20Name'%2C%0A%20%20%20%20'install_requires'%3A%20%5B'requests%3E%3D2.20.0'%5D%2C%20%23%20%E5%81%87%E8%AE%BE%E4%BE%9D%E8%B5%96requests%E5%BA%93%0A%20%20%20%20'packages'%3A%20setuptools.find_packages%28%29%2C%20%23%20%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%9F%A5%E6%89%BE%E5%8C%85%0A%7D%0A%0Aprint%28f%22%5Cn%E6%A8%A1%E6%8B%9F%E5%8C%85%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E5%AE%9A%E4%B9%89%20%28%7Bpackage_info%5B'name'%5D%7D%20v%7Bpackage_info%5B'version'%5D%7D%29%3A%22%29%0Aprint%28f%22%20%20%E6%8F%8F%E8%BF%B0%3A%20%7Bpackage_info%5B'description'%5D%7D%22%29%0Aprint%28f%22%20%20%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85%3A%20%7Bpackage_info%5B'author'%5D%7D%22%29%0Aprint%28f%22%20%20%E6%89%80%E9%9C%80%E4%BE%9D%E8%B5%96%3A%20%7Bpackage_info%5B'install_requires'%5D%7D%22%29%0A%0A%23%20setuptools.setup%28%29%20%E5%9C%A8%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E4%B8%AD%E4%BC%9A%E5%9C%A8%E8%BF%99%E9%87%8C%E8%A2%AB%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%0A%23%20print%28%22%5Cn%E5%9C%A8%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E9%A1%B9%E7%9B%AE%E4%B8%AD%EF%BC%8Csetuptools.setup%28%29%20%E5%B0%86%E8%A2%AB%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%8C%E5%B9%B6%E4%BC%A0%E5%85%A5%E4%BB%A5%E4%B8%8A%E4%BF%A1%E6%81%AF%E8%BF%9B%E8%A1%8C%E5%8C%85%E7%9A%84%E6%9E%84%E5%BB%BA%E5%92%8C%E5%8F%91%E5%B8%83%E3%80%82%22%29%0A%0A%23%20%E6%A3%80%E6%9F%A5%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%EF%BC%8C%E5%8F%AA%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E6%BC%94%E7%A4%BA%E7%9B%AE%E7%9A%84%0Aif%20setuptools.__version__%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28f%22%5Cn%E5%BD%93%E5%89%8D%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E7%9A%84%20setuptools%20%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%3A%20%7Bsetuptools.__version__%7D%22%29%0Aelse%3A%0A%20%20%20%20print%28%22%E6%97%A0%E6%B3%95%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%20setuptools%20%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%E3%80%82%22%29%0A"
